title: Magnetically regulated collapse in the B335 protostar?. II. Observational constraints on gas ionization and magnetic field coupling
question: To observationally characterize the level of gas ionization at small envelope radii (<= 1000 au) and investigate its relation to the efficiency of magnetic field coupling in the Class 0 protostar B335.

recipe.goal: Extract integrated intensity maps and pixel-by-pixel spectral maps, and model line profiles with two velocity components
recipe.method: Integrate molecular line emission over emitting velocity ranges to create moment 0 maps; extract pixel-by-pixel spectra and fit two independent velocity components simultaneously at each pixel using HfS.
assumptions: Two independent velocity components; optically thin line emission (no resolved hyperfine structure for DCO+ and H13CO+)

recipe.goal: Compute column densities and deuteration fraction (R_D) maps for each velocity component
recipe.method: Calculate column densities of DCO+ (J=3-2) and H13CO+ (J=3-2) using Eq. 2 and take their ratio scaled by the 12C/13C abundance ratio (Eq. 1).
key_parameters: Spectroscopic parameters from Table 1: log(A/s^-1) = -3.12, g_u = 7, Q_rot = 25.22, E_l = 7.21 cm^-1 for DCO+ (3-2); log(A/s^-1) = -2.87, g_u = 7, Q_rot = 22.91, E_l = 8.68 cm^-1 for H13CO+ (3-2)
assumptions: LTE with excitation temperature T_ex = T_d = 25 K, background temperature T_bg = 2.7 K, and spatial coexistence of DCO+ and H13CO+

recipe.goal: Derive H2 column density, C17O column density, and CO depletion factor (f_D) map
recipe.method: Calculate N_H2 from primary-beam-corrected 110 GHz dust continuum (Eq. 6 & 7) and N_C17O from C17O (J=1-0) integrated emission (Eq. 2), smoothed to match the DCO+ beam; compute f_D as the ratio of expected to observed CO column density (Eq. 5).
key_parameters: kappa_0 = 1.6 cm^2 g^-1 at 1.3 mm, beta = 0.76, gas-to-dust ratio chi_d = 100, mu_H2 = 2.8, T_d = 25 K, X_CO = 10^-4, f_C17O = 2317
assumptions: Constant dust and gas excitation temperature of 25 K; standard dust properties and gas-to-dust ratio of 100.

recipe.goal: Compute gas ionization fraction (chi_e) and cosmic-ray ionization rate (zeta_CR) maps, and fit radial power-law profiles of zeta_CR
recipe.method: Use Caselli et al. (1998) analytical relations (Eqs. 3 and 4) combining R_D, f_D, volume density n_H2 = N_H2 / L, and hydrogenation fraction R_H (from H13CO+ 1-0 and C17O 1-0, Eq. 8); extract radial median profiles of zeta_CR over position angles and fit broken power laws.
key_parameters: Core diameter L = 1720 au; break radius r = 270 au; radial profile range 40 to 700 au over position angles 0 <= vartheta <= pi
assumptions: Simple steady-state chemical network of Caselli et al. (1998); uniform line-of-sight core depth L = 1720 au.
